name: ts-capture-monorepo
description: ts-capture — turn runtime values into TypeScript types, and check existing types against them

scripts.examples: pnpm --filter @ts-capture/core run build && pnpm --filter @ts-capture/examples-site run build && pnpm --filter @ts-capture/examples-site run site
scripts.demo: pnpm --filter @ts-capture/core --filter @ts-capture/vite --filter @ts-capture/examples-site --filter @ts-capture/demo run build && pnpm --filter @ts-capture/demo run record
scripts.og-image: pnpm --filter @ts-capture/core --filter @ts-capture/examples-site --filter @ts-capture/demo run build && pnpm --filter @ts-capture/demo run og-image
